fail.quote: Read the original bytes into memory and confirm the target byte sequence occurs exactly once. If it does not, stop without editing and report the discrepancy.
fail.reason: The added targeting repair counts raw b"npm instal" occurrences without distinguishing the typo from already-correct "npm install" text, of which it is a prefix. A README that already contains "npm install" alongside the one typo would show multiple matches and the run would falsely abort. This introduces a new targeting defect instead of correctly repairing one.
